notes: «وَ رُوِيَ فِي حَدِيثٍ آخَرَ» names no transmitter; the Imam's words («قال أبو عبد الله ع») are the only named link (rule 10, owner ruling 2). The kunya is written as it stands (owner ruling 3).
«وَ رُوِيَ فِي حَدِيثٍ آخَرَ» names no transmitter; the Imam's words («قال أبو عبد الله ع») are the only named link (rule 10, owner ruling 2). The kunya is written as it stands (owner ruling 3).
No transmitter is written before the Imam («وَ رُوِیَ فِی حَدِیثٍ آخَرَ»): the single link is the Imam named after «قَالَ» (rule 10, owner ruling 2).
